svg.text: One mma.sync accumulator tile (16 × 8, FP32): which lane holds which value
For the m16n8k16 shape, the 16 × 8 accumulator
is spread over the warp: 4 values per lane.
lane l holds rows l / 4 and l / 4 + 8,
columns 2 × (l mod 4) and the one after it.
Knowing the layout lets a kernel scale the results,
add a bias or apply an activation right in the
registers, before anything is written to memory.
WMMA hides this layout; mma.sync documents it.
